baseline.legacy_loading_policy: Retain the existing strict v1 loading and default H0 behavior. A v2 migration may only initialize an explicit allowlist of new parameters; mismatched legacy tensors must fail.

implementation_scope.necessary_interface_adaptation: Construct the D2 4x4 target lattice directly from the predicted D8 parent correspondence in all no-H0 experiments.
preserved_structure: Global D8 cosine matching, FP32 dual-softmax and chunked execution

data_policy.validation_role: Select flow prior hyperparameters, training mixture and update budget before locked evaluation.
data_policy.googleearth_val_directory_policy: Test_Data/GoogleEarth/val is locked evaluation data despite its directory name; it is different from MHINet_RGB_512/val and must not select hyperparameters.
data_policy.reproducibility: Register fixed manifest hashes, source-image identity audit, initialization hash, seed, update budget, match caps and code identity before every run; do not infer geographic isolation from source-image isolation.
data_policy.manual_gcp_policy: Only completed and reviewed human annotations are eligible. Report GCP geometry evaluation separately from synthetic-H correspondence evaluation; offline fitted H never enters v2 inference.

split_policy.active_data_scope: Only fixed RGB_512 train/val; sealed evaluation is not read for this campaign.

matching.temperature_policy: Preserve learned D8/D2 temperatures from the fixed initialization; 0.05 is only the legacy constructor initialization.
matching.max_matches_role: Legacy-compatible pre-QRRU candidate budget, independent of the final max_output_matches limit.

output_limit_policy.validation: A positive integer; booleans, zero, negative and fractional values are rejected.
output_limit_policy.scope: Per image pair, final valid matches only.
output_limit_policy.application_stage: After QRRU refinement and final finite/in-bounds filtering; before any RANSAC fitting or export.
output_limit_policy.selection: Stable descending confidence; tied scores retain the original match order. Apply identical selected indices to every per-match field, including points_a, points_b, confidence, fine_points_b and lineage if present; pre-cap candidate diagnostics keep separately documented semantics.
output_limit_policy.shortfall: Return all available valid matches when fewer than the cap, including empty outputs. Never pad, duplicate or fetch discarded candidates to fill the cap.
output_limit_policy.gt_policy: No GT-guided selection. Never use the output limit to constrain the global D8 search.
output_limit_policy.checkpoint_policy: Keep legacy max_matches=12000 as the pre-QRRU candidate budget when migrating; absence of the new output field uses the v2 default 2048.

flow_guidance.hyperparameter_status: Registered initial lambda=3 and sigma_d8=4 for the first campaign; no claim of full-validation optimality.
flow_guidance.candidate_support: All D8 cells on both sides; invalid, out-of-bounds or unreliable Flow predictions contribute zero reward and do not reject the image pair.
flow_guidance.coordinate_contract: A-to-B, align_corners=False cell-center normalized coordinates. flow16_norm = flow16_target_norm - source_grid16. Interpolate displacement to D8, add source_grid8, and compute Gaussian distances in D8 pixels.

qrru.adapter_initialization: Zero-initialize both 1x1 residual adapters; retain legacy encoder tensor shapes and names.
qrru.control_interpolation: Reuse interpolate_controls with actual control positions +/-1 and feature offsets +/-1.5, including its polynomial extrapolation.
qrru.mask_policy: Use real source and warped-target sampling validity plus patch-neighborhood validity; mask invalid neighbors and define a finite fallback for an empty neighborhood. Do not use GT masks at inference.
qrru.first_iteration_dgfo: Zero initial controls imply zero propagated flow and zero DGFO residual; discrepancy remains an independent branch from the first iteration.

initial_experiment_settings.input_size_policy: Only 512x512 model inputs are supported or accepted in MHI v2. Reject other model input sizes explicitly; legacy checkpoint size support does not extend the v2 contract.

training_plan.optimizer_policy: Fresh optimizer and scheduler for v2; never resume the v1 optimizer across architecture changes.

flow_head_stage.interface_requirement: Separate locator prediction from H fitting and split geo/mat/cls losses from the H loss; setting h_weight=0 alone does not remove existing H-output dependencies.

training_input_mixture.eligibility: Only GT-visible predicted correspondences whose target and valid control errors fit the registered <=6 D2-pixel correction range; severe mismatches are excluded and counted separately.
training_input_mixture.selection_policy: Registered first-campaign mixture; only original RGB_512 train/val may diagnose it, and sealed evaluation cannot change it.
training_input_mixture.shortfall_policy: Fill missing eligible predicted-D2 slots with GT-noise samples; log actual predicted/noise query counts instead of claiming an exact 50/50 mixture in every batch.

qrru_stages.controlled_comparison: Independently initialize C/D/E from the same selected Flow Head checkpoint, whose legacy QRRU remains the frozen v1 initialization; share fixed C D2 cache, data order, seed42, 5 epochs/25535 optimizer updates and full-val selection rules. D adds zero-initialized discrepancy and E adds zero-initialized DGFO. Retain frozen C for same-weight B-to-C prior contrast.

legacy_qrru_control.matched_arm_policy: Train the original QRRU without new branches on the identical mixture and budget used for D/E; compare this arm with D to isolate discrepancy.

qrru_stages.f_control: For the primary E-versus-F inference contrast, reuse the same E-trained weights and only disable the Flow prior. Any additional F training on B-generated D2 inputs is a separately registered equal-budget run.

training_plan.joint_training: Optional only after separate Flow and QRRU gains pass stage acceptance; define its own freeze policy and preregistered budget.
training_plan.trainable_configuration_status: Executable independent v2 configs and explicit mhinet.v2.train/evaluate entrypoints implemented; the experiment registry itself remains non-executable.

evaluation_plan.output_cap_comparison_policy: A-F main comparisons share max_output_matches=2048, the same pre-QRRU max_matches=12000 budget and post-QRRU validity/selection rules. Any override or optional cap is a separately labeled comparison applied uniformly to its participating groups.

legacy_baseline_rescoring.policy: Frozen historical A final NPZs may be stably confidence-capped to 2048 after confirming their 512 input, pre-QRRU budget, validity and ordering match this protocol. Recompute all metrics, including NM/NCM/coverage/RANSAC/RMSE and Pre@10. Label as offline rescoring; never call this an original max_matches=2048 rerun.
legacy_baseline_rescoring.historical_metrics_policy: Keep original 12000-candidate historical reports unchanged and label their different output protocol; do not copy their scores into the new 2048 main table.
legacy_baseline_rescoring.timing_policy: Offline capping cannot establish new inference latency; measure new runs under the same timing protocol for speed comparisons.

stop_conditions: If Flow predictions are inaccurate and geometric rewards promote wrong candidates, stop increasing lambda and first improve independent Flow supervision.
If D8 improves but Direct-D8 fine matching loses too many correct candidates, stop attributing the issue to QRRU; any new D2 geometry model requires a separate experiment.
If DGFO has no repeatable Pre@3 benefit over discrepancy-only QRRU at matched budget, retain the simpler discrepancy model. Match-count growth alone is insufficient.
source_isolation_policy: Legacy source, CLI and reference-kernel hashes remain unchanged. Put v2-specific implementations in mhinet/v2, with explicit v2 entrypoints; reuse stable legacy utilities by import and preserve checkpoint key names through tested migration.
